# GBX Professional Services

> Melbourne consultancy with two practices. Business performance and AI readiness: GBX Professional Services helps professional-services firms, advice practices and other regulated businesses run more clearly, sell more confidently and adopt AI with discipline. Financial education: plain-language money education programs for workplaces (The Financial Fluency Program) and client education seminars for advice and accounting practices (Client Education Series). Founded 17 January 2024.

GBX Professional Services does not hold an Australian Financial Services Licence (AFSL) and does not provide financial product advice or any other financial service. Investment-related work is operational, analytical and educational support to licensed professionals only.

## Start here
- [The Performance Diagnostic](https://gbxps.com/diagnostic): A fixed-scope ten-day diagnostic, run at the client's pace with no interruption to the business, from $4,500 + GST, credited in full against a delivery engagement that starts within 60 days: interviews, a review of your numbers, systems and processes, a prioritised opportunity map and a 90-day plan the client owns. Preceded by a free two-minute Business Health Check and a free diagnostic call.

## Financial education
- [Financial Education Programs](https://gbxps.com/education): The Financial Fluency Program for workplaces (six plain-language modules on money, super, investing concepts, tax basics, protection and life moments, as a staff benefit) and the Client Education Series for advice and accounting practices. General education only, not financial product advice.
- [Workplace Financial Wellbeing Check](https://gbxps.com/tools/wellbeing-check): A free eight-question check for HR and people leaders on how well the organisation supports staff with financial education.

## Services
- [Services](https://gbxps.com/services): Seven disciplines: business analytics and performance, business success consulting, business AI readiness, brand and marketing, sales enablement and lead generation, financial and compliance education, and investment frameworks and adviser support.
- [Approach](https://gbxps.com/approach): A four-stage method: Health Check, Scope, Deliver, Sustain.
- [Leadership](https://gbxps.com/leadership): A systems leader, a thought leader and an education leader.
- [Global reach](https://gbxps.com/reach): Melbourne-based, delivering globally through a partner network across Australia, Asia, the Middle East and North America.

## Tools and Insights
- [Tools & Insights](https://gbxps.com/tools): Free tools and articles.
- [Business Health Check](https://gbxps.com/tools/health-check): A free two-minute scorecard across finance, sales, operations, marketing, systems and AI.
- [Capacity & Profit Calculator](https://gbxps.com/tools/capacity): What a team could deliver, what it delivers today, and the revenue left on the table.
- [Pipeline Gap Calculator](https://gbxps.com/tools/pipeline-gap): The clients, leads and win rate a revenue target needs.
- [Automation Opportunity Finder](https://gbxps.com/tools/automation): Hours a week that could be automated, and where to start.
- [Will AI Actually Help?](https://gbxps.com/tools/will-ai-help): A decision game: choose a sector, pass six doors (a repeating task, written-down information, a review step, enough hours, data that can move, an owner) and get an honest answer on whether AI will help yet, with the one thing to do first.
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://gbxps.com/tools/ai-readiness): Readiness tier across use cases, data, process, governance and capability.
- [Team Capability Check](https://gbxps.com/tools/capability): How a practice builds and evidences capability, from onboarding to compliance training.
- [KPI Starter Kit](https://gbxps.com/tools/kpi-starter): The six KPIs worth watching for a business and its goal, with definitions, targets and cadence.
- [Marketing Rhythm Planner](https://gbxps.com/tools/marketing-rhythm): A weekly, monthly and quarterly marketing rhythm sized to the hours available.
- [Unit Economics Calculator](https://gbxps.com/tools/unit-economics): Lifetime value, acquisition cost, ratio and payback.
- [Positioning Statement Builder](https://gbxps.com/tools/positioning): A positioning statement, one-line pitch and elevator version.
- [Prompt Optimizer](https://gbxps.com/tools/prompt-optimizer/): A browser-based tool that turns a rough idea into a clear, model-tailored AI prompt.
- [Insights](https://gbxps.com/insights): Practical articles across AI, marketing, business analytics, new business tools, sales, investment research and financial education.
